en: A black-and-white postcard view of a mountainous valley landscape. In the middle distance stands a large historic building complex that resembles a castle or manor, surrounded by trees and cultivated fields. Hills and terraced slopes rise in the background. Tree branches frame the scene in the foreground, along with a simple wooden fence. Along the bottom border, printed text identifies the location as Castelfondo in Val di Non at an elevation of 947 meters.
